critique: The render now has a substantially fuller orange-on-black rising ember field, and the t1-to-t4 change clearly communicates upward movement. The broadening at the upper portion is more plume-like than prior iterations. However, it still reads as a collection of uniformly circular, soft orange bokeh dots rather than a turbulent Smoke-and-Fire ember plume: the center lacks a concentrated fiery source/core, particle paths remain fairly orderly, and the very high feathering makes the embers overly diffuse.

suggestions.why: Increase directional spread so the ascending particles fan and churn laterally, creating a less orderly, more turbulent plume silhouette.
Increase maximum particle size to establish a stronger bright ember/fire core among the smaller particles.
Reduce excessive softness so the larger embers retain a brighter, more fire-like center instead of reading as uniformly blurred dots.
